text:
Type: set of two rectangular nesting tables
Use: holding drinks, books or a lamp beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, mid-century modern, minimalist
Materials: painted tops, dark stained solid wood frames
Colors: light beige, dark brown
Shape: two flat rectangular tops, one taller and one lower, rounded sled-like side frames with a crossbar, smaller one slides under the larger, light and open
Feel: calm, warm, refined, flexible
Goes with: beige or brown upholstery, warm wood, cream walls; contemporary or mid-century living rooms

product.name: RISSNA
product.description: Can be used individually or be pushed together to save space.
